## Notable Projects
- **LaporJurnal**: Scientific Journal Integrity Verification & Reporting Platform built with Python 3.12, Streamlit Web GUI, Interactive CLI, and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) with resilient atomic CSV storage and PBKDF2 hashing.
- **CleanWash**: On-Demand Laundry Marketplace built with Laravel 11, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, and Midtrans payment gateway.
- **Smart Parking System**: Desktop parking management application developed in Java implementing OOP architecture and Swing GUI.
- **ToDoo**: Fast productivity web application built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
